# COSMOS-Web v1.1 Source Mirror Schema

Generated from the sealed 1,416-row dictionary and a verified live `cosmos2025_v11.source` catalog observation. The eleven mirror tables are lossless source representations after declared target casting. Cleaned, expanded, or science-derived products belong in a future `analysis` schema.

Only FITS masks and NaN become SQL NULL. Every finite sentinel remains a source value unless a future analysis contract explicitly changes it.

## Identifier and relational metadata contract

Every listing places the exact source column beside its PostgreSQL target identifier, including all punctuation and case mappings. Normalization follows the frozen Gate 3.1 contract:

1. Lowercase the exact `source_column`.
2. Replace every maximal run outside `[a-z0-9_]` with one underscore.
3. Prefix `c_` when the result does not begin with `[a-z_]` or equals a PostgreSQL Appendix C reserved word.
4. Halt on an invalid result, a duplicate table/target pair, or an identifier longer than 63 UTF-8 bytes. PostgreSQL truncation and collision repair are forbidden; identifiers are never hand-disambiguated.

The authorized metadata names are explicit rather than normalized. Seven master tables carry a zero-based `source_row`; the other six master extensions receive primary-photometry `id` at the same upstream ordinal. This injected-ID contract depends on the verified cross-HDU upstream ordinal alignment and is not an independent source-key join.

## Array index to aperture mapping

Primary-photometry five-element aperture vectors use index order **0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.75, 1** arcsecond diameter, sourced from `cosmosweb-dr1-detailed-column-descriptions.txt` section 1 descriptions.

SE++ aperture-photometry five-element vectors use index order **0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5** arcsecond diameter, sourced from `cosmosweb-dr1-detailed-column-descriptions.txt` section 3 descriptions.

## Provenance infrastructure

`source.provenance` is project infrastructure, not a twelfth source mirror. Provenance contract version 1.0.1 contains thirteen fields and one registered row for each of the eleven mirrors.

| Field | PostgreSQL type | Nullable | Primary key | Check | Comment |
|-------|-----------------|----------|-------------|-------|---------|
<!-- provenance-field:table_name -->
| `table_name` | `text` | no | yes | [not documented] | Mirror table identity; one provenance row is permitted per loaded table. |
<!-- provenance-field:source_file -->
| `source_file` | `text` | no | no | [not documented] | Source artifact file name used for this table load. |
<!-- provenance-field:source_path -->
| `source_path` | `text` | no | no | [not documented] | Configured source artifact path used for this table load. |
<!-- provenance-field:manifest_sha256 -->
| `manifest_sha256` | `text` | no | no | {column} ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' | Manifest-pinned lowercase SHA-256 digest for the source artifact. |
<!-- provenance-field:observed_sha256 -->
| `observed_sha256` | `text` | no | no | {column} ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' | Lowercase SHA-256 digest observed from the source artifact at load time. |
<!-- provenance-field:source_rows -->
| `source_rows` | `bigint` | no | no | {column} >= 0 | Source row count observed before the table load. |
<!-- provenance-field:loaded_rows -->
| `loaded_rows` | `bigint` | no | no | {column} >= 0 | Rows committed to the mirror table by the load. |
<!-- provenance-field:load_timestamp -->
| `load_timestamp` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | no | [not documented] | Timestamp of the provenance-registration transaction performed after mirror load verification; not the historical table-load commit timestamp. |
<!-- provenance-field:manifest_ref -->
| `manifest_ref` | `text` | no | no | [not documented] | Repository-relative or configured reference to the source manifest. |
<!-- provenance-field:manifest_ref_sha256 -->
| `manifest_ref_sha256` | `text` | no | no | {column} ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' | Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the referenced manifest artifact. |
<!-- provenance-field:catalog_version -->
| `catalog_version` | `text` | no | no | [not documented] | Catalog release label represented by the loaded table. |
<!-- provenance-field:supplement_version -->
| `supplement_version` | `text` | no | no | [not documented] | Explicit supplement release label or load-time not-applicable marker. |
<!-- provenance-field:notes -->
| `notes` | `text` | yes | no | [not documented] | Optional load-specific provenance notes; no science-derived values. |
